entities.summary: Cardinal Guillaume, Guillermo or William de Croÿ, a member of the noble House of Croÿ, was Prince-Bishop of Cambrai from 1516 to 1519 and Archbishop of Toledo from 1517 to 1521. He was born in the Habsburg Netherlands and died in Worms, Germany.

entities.summary:
William de Croÿ, Prince-Bishop of Cambrai from 1516 to 1519 and Archbishop of Toledo from 1517 to 1521, was a key figure in the Habsburg Netherlands during the tumultuous transition from the Burgundian to the Spanish Habsburgs.

Born in 1498 in the Habsburg Netherlands, Guillaume's rise to power was facilitated by his connections to the powerful Croÿ family and his own diplomatic prowess.

As Cardinal Guillaume, he played a pivotal role in the Spanish Inquisition, advocating for the persecution of heretics and Jews in the newly conquered territories of the Americas.
